text: I wish I had talked with you <@U091JB6G6V9> at DD2030 about deterministic/accountability challenges for voting/pre-voting deliberation and about how institutions can promote transparency and algorithmic accountability, in addition to some of the side topics such as other means of deliberation like citizen assemblies, digital moderation (like MIT CCC, and others) and the recent paper, Five dimensions of scaling democratic deliberation (especially scaling in), or other IRL conversation to understand each other like what BridgeUSA promotes. I see different views and takes of these areas.
